items.label: Comfortable with Mild Stretch
items.value: Crafted from a blend of 70.2% Cotton, 26.4% Polyester, 2.2% Rayon, and 1.2% Spandex. This soft fabric offers comfortable four-way mild stretch, balancing the comfort of cotton with freedom of movement, and is designed to resist sagging for all-season wear

items.label: Retro Flare Silhouette & Stretch Waist
items.value: Featuring a mid-rise waist and a relaxed fit that elegantly flares from the knee down with a raw hem, creating a vintage-inspired look. The combination of a button fly and a stretch waistband offers easy wear and a forgiving fit. Functional front and back pockets complete the classic denim aesthetic

items.label: Creates Versatile Styles
items.value: Its distinctive silhouette is a key piece for styled looks. Pair it with crop tops, fitted knits, or oversized blouses to achieve a fashionable proportion. It effortlessly complements canvas shoes for a retro casual vibe or platforms and ankle boots for a more statement look

items.label: For Casual & Stylish Occasions
items.value: Thanks to its comfort and standout style, it's perfect for daily casual wear, campus, shopping, travel, festivals, and casual social gatherings. Its retro-chic vibe also adds an effortless flair to urban outings or cafe dates

items.label: Easy Care Instructions
items.value: For best care, we recommend machine washing in cold water or hand washing separately with like colors. Do not bleach, tumble dry, or dry clean. Air drying is suggested to maintain the shape. Please consult the size chart in the listing for the perfect fit

items.label: Occasion Type
items.value: business casual, dressy casual, going out, lounge, party
